Last Island, an open-world island city game for the live terminal

Press the blue game button above. The window opens at half the screen; the small, half and full buttons on its title bar change the size. Click the game to board the airship, press Space to jump, steer your dive, and be the last stick standing out of 20.

Controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, click to attack, right-click to aim, Shift to sprint, Space to jump, R to reload, 1 to 6 to switch weapons, Q to heal, E to open chests, swap weapons and drive cars, M for sound, Esc to pause. The graphics button on the title bar switches between high, med and low; if your PC struggles it steps down by itself.

The game: an open-world city of skyscrapers, shops and parks on an island with snowy mountains and wild animals. Traffic drives the streets and people walk the sidewalks. Steal any car, earn cash from courier jobs (press J), buy guns at the gun shop, open glowing chests, and hunt the mythic weapons on the tower and mountain tops. Wanted stars bring the police; stay out of sight to lose them. Your health comes back when you stay out of trouble, and if you get knocked out you wake up at the hospital.

It pauses itself when you press Esc, click outside it or switch tabs, and then the terminal's own keys work again. Closed, it uses no CPU. It reads none of your trading data.

Placement: option A, opened from the masthead button, now with small, half and full sizes.
